title: AI Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time AI Software Engineer to join our US client's team. You should have a minimum of 3 to 5+ years of experience developing and delivering commercial software, with a solid background in AI/ML, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and C#/ .NET.

In this role, you will leverage deep expertise in NLP and ML to help build scalable, production-grade language technology systems. This position is ideal for someone passionate about transformer models, audio processing, large-scale data pipelines, and real-world ML deployments.

You will have a high impact on shaping the future of language accessibility and global communication through sophisticated, scalable ML systems. If you're excited to build at the intersection of language, audio, and AI, and to do so in a real-world product used globally, we'd love to meet you.

Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide by leveraging cutting-edge speech and language AI to power solutions such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S., Europe, and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable ML-based systems focused on language processing, speech recognition, and real-time communication technologies
  • Train and fine-tune transformer-based models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, BERT, T5) for tasks such as audio transcription, classification, summarization, and conversational AI
  • Develop and deploy ML-powered microservices and APIs that integrate tightly with the platform's cloud infrastructure
  • Build and manage robust data pipelines for multilingual speech and text datasets, including cleaning, augmentation, and validation
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into production workflows with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and user experience
  • Apply software engineering best practices to assure performance, scalability, and maintainability using secure coding principles, automated unit testing, code reviews, horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, microservice architectures, and continuous integration CI/CD pipelines
  • Troubleshoot, isolate root causes, and provide innovative solutions in reasonable timeframes
  • Conduct research to evaluate and adopt emerging ML methods, with a focus on efficient inference, transfer learning, and low-latency deployment
  • Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development and AI


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3 to 5+ years of hands-on software development experience using Python, TypeScript, and C#/.NET
  • Agile development experience
  • Solid background in machine learning, with experience in supervised and unsupervised algorithms
  • Practical experience with transformers, generative models, and LLMs in NLP or audio processing
  • Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, TorchAudio, OpenAI APIs, or similar platforms
  • Expertise in developing REST APIs and microservices in production environments
  • Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Strong knowledge of AWS (S3, ECS, SageMaker, CloudWatch, Load Balancer Controller, and more)
  • Experience with NoSQL and RDBMS databases
  • Proficient in Git, Jira, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Experience building ML-based products for interpretation, transcription, or conversational interfaces
  • Previous exposure to the Microsoft Orleans distributed systems framework
  • Familiarity with Pulumi, GCP, or Azure as alternative cloud environments
  • Knowledge of innovation accelerators or previous work with AI startup toolkits
  • Familiarity with real-time data streaming and low-latency model serving

title: Sap Quality Management Consultant
description:
SAP QM Consultant (Contract) – Pharma Industry / LIMS Integration


Location: Brazil – Remote / Hybrid (depending on project)

Contract Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor

Duration: 12 months (extendable)


About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced SAP QM Consultant (Contractor) to support SAP S/4HANA implementation and enhancement projects for clients in the pharmaceutical sector .

The consultant will play a key role in designing and configuring SAP QM processes, ensuring seamless integration with LIMS (Laboratory Information Management Systems) , and maintaining compliance with GxP and pharmaceutical quality standards .

This is an excellent opportunity for independent SAP professionals who enjoy project-based work, flexibility, and the chance to collaborate in a global, regulated environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Configure and support SAP QM processes (inspection lots, results recording, batch management, certificates).
  • Design and manage SAP–LIMS integrations (LabVantage, LabWare, or equivalent).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (PP-PI, MM, WM/EWM) to align manufacturing and quality processes.
  • Ensure full GxP compliance and support validation, testing, and documentation.
  • Participate in template design, rollouts, and process improvements across global sites.
  • Provide training, functional support, and issue resolution during cutover and go-live.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of proven experience as an SAP QM Consultant .
  • Strong background in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry.
  • Hands-on LIMS integration experience (e.g., LabVantage, LabWare, etc.).
  • Working knowledge of S/4HANA , IDoc/qRFC/Web Services , and interface technologies .
  • Understanding of GMP/GxP validation and quality control processes.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is an advantage).
  • Availability to work remotely or hybrid within Brazil under a contractor model (PJ or freelance) .

title: Data Modeler
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The Data Modeler will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust data models and SQL-based solutions, with a focus on Google Cloud Platform. This role will ensure data integrity, optimize database performance, and support data-driven initiatives, particularly within the higher education sector.


Duties and Responsibilities:

Data Modelling and SQL Development

  • Design and implement scalable and efficient relational and dimensional data models.
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and functions.
  • Ensure data quality and integrity across various data sources and reporting layers.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into technical specifications.


Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Expertise

  • Utilize GCP services such as BigQuery, Cloud SQL, and Dataflow for data storage, processing, and analysis.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based data warehouses and data lakes on GCP.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions for GCP data environments using tools like Terraform.
  • Monitor and optimize GCP resource performance and cost for data platforms.


Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary liaison among business leads, product managers, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for data solutions.
  • Promote adoption of new data capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.


Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for data model and SQL deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for data solutions.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics related to data platforms.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational database design and data modelling.
  • Demonstrable experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data services (e.g., BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Dataflow).
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code solutions, e.g., Terraform.
  • Experience with data quality checks and data governance best practices.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience in the higher education space.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools for data platforms.
  • Familiarity with Python for data scripting and automation.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 5+ years in SQL engineering, data modelling, data engineering, or a related data-centric role, preferably within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Data Migration Specialist - Brazil
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Data Migration Specialist - Brazil , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract hybrid or remote.


In this role you will:

The Data Migration Specialist is responsible for transitioning and transforming data from legacy systems to new platforms. The specialist will ensure data integrity, security, and accessibility throughout the migration process, thus supporting the organization's strategic initiatives and operational efficiency. The professional will proactively identify and mitigate risks, ensuring a smooth and successful transition with minimal disruption to business operations.


Main Responsibilities:

  • Data Migration and Transformation: Design and implement data migration processes. Develop scripts, ETL processes ( Extract, Transform, Load) and tools for data migration, adapted to the specific requirements of the project. Utilize SQL, data mapping, and transformation techniques to optimize efficiency.
  • Data Integrity and Quality: Ensure data integrity and validation during the migration process. Perform regular audits and validation checks to verify the accuracy and completeness of the migrated data. Oversee user acceptance testing (UAT) and adjust the migration approach as needed.
  • Project and Risk Management: Plan and manage data migration projects, including resource allocation and schedule management. Identify and mitigate the risks associated with data migration, developing proactive strategies to address potential challenges.
  • Compliance and Governance: Ensuring that data migration processes comply with industry standards and regulations. Adhere to organizational policies and procedures.
  • Documentation and Communication: Generate regular progress reports for stakeholders. Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for all data migration activities, ensuring transparency, accountability, and knowledge sharing.

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills):

  • Experience: Minimum of 8 to 10 years of experience. At least 5 years of experience in data migration and management.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Technical Tools and Skills:
  • Proficiency in SQL and data migration tools like Talend, Informatica .
  • Experience with database management systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle ) to manage and migrate data.
  • Proven knowledge and experience in the design and implementation of ETL processes.
  • Advanced English and/or French.

Soft Skills:

  • Problem Solving: Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Communication: Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail.
  • Adaptability: Ability to work independently and in a team.
  • Project Management: Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Differentials (Nice to Have):

  • Education: Master's degree in a related field.
  • Certifications: Certification in data management (e.g., CDMP) or advanced certifications in data migration tools (e.g., Talend, Informatica ).
  • Knowledge: Experience with data migration to the cloud (AWS, Azure ). Familiarity with agile project management methodologies. Knowledge of data security and privacy regulations.

title: Data Engineer - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.

What we are looking for:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Data Migration Specialist - Brazil
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Data Migration Specialist - Brazil , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract hybrid or remote.


In this role you will:

The Data Migration Specialist is responsible for transitioning and transforming data from legacy systems to new platforms. The specialist will ensure data integrity, security, and accessibility throughout the migration process, thus supporting the organization's strategic initiatives and operational efficiency. The professional will proactively identify and mitigate risks, ensuring a smooth and successful transition with minimal disruption to business operations.


Main Responsibilities:

  • Data Migration and Transformation: Design and implement data migration processes. Develop scripts, ETL processes ( Extract, Transform, Load) and tools for data migration, adapted to the specific requirements of the project. Utilize SQL, data mapping, and transformation techniques to optimize efficiency.
  • Data Integrity and Quality: Ensure data integrity and validation during the migration process. Perform regular audits and validation checks to verify the accuracy and completeness of the migrated data. Oversee user acceptance testing (UAT) and adjust the migration approach as needed.
  • Project and Risk Management: Plan and manage data migration projects, including resource allocation and schedule management. Identify and mitigate the risks associated with data migration, developing proactive strategies to address potential challenges.
  • Compliance and Governance: Ensuring that data migration processes comply with industry standards and regulations. Adhere to organizational policies and procedures.
  • Documentation and Communication: Generate regular progress reports for stakeholders. Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for all data migration activities, ensuring transparency, accountability, and knowledge sharing.

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills):

  • Experience: Minimum of 8 to 10 years of experience. At least 5 years of experience in data migration and management.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Technical Tools and Skills:
  • Proficiency in SQL and data migration tools like Talend, Informatica .
  • Experience with database management systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle ) to manage and migrate data.
  • Proven knowledge and experience in the design and implementation of ETL processes.
  • Advanced English and/or French.

Soft Skills:

  • Problem Solving: Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Communication: Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail.
  • Adaptability: Ability to work independently and in a team.
  • Project Management: Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Differentials (Nice to Have):

  • Education: Master's degree in a related field.
  • Certifications: Certification in data management (e.g., CDMP) or advanced certifications in data migration tools (e.g., Talend, Informatica ).
  • Knowledge: Experience with data migration to the cloud (AWS, Azure ). Familiarity with agile project management methodologies. Knowledge of data security and privacy regulations.

title: Analista de Quality Assurance Pleno
description:
Quem somos

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção digital global, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, a Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


Sobre a Vaga

Você será responsável por entregar projetos digitais “limpos”, seguindo planos de testes e criando tickets de bugs impecáveis, conforme os protocolos de qualidade global. Também será responsável pela garantia de qualidade com foco na funcionalidade e compatibilidade dos projetos analisados. Os tickets de bugs registrados devem ser escritos do ponto de vista técnico e podem incluir sugestões de correções ou soluções alternativas. Nossos projetos são baseados principalmente em ações de marketing focadas em e-mails marketing e banners que precisam estar em conformidade com os diferentes navegadores, sistemas operacionais e dispositivos, garantindo o correto carregamentos em todos eles.


Responsabilidades

• Garantir que a equipe de desenvolvimento tenha sempre a lista de todos as versões de dispositivos, sistemas operacionais e navegadores que serão usados nos testes para garantir uma entrega de qualidade.

• Assumir a propriedade dos projetos de controle de qualidade atribuídos desde o início até à entrega;

• Executar planos eficazes para controle de qualidade, revisão e auditorias, entregando projetos “limpos” e livres de bugs;

• Contribuir para o design e validar a funcionalidade dos conceitos de design;

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com gerentes de projetos e desenvolvedores para garantir a qualidade e a conclusão dos projetos no prazo;

• Desenvolver materiais de boas práticas para que os demais grupos adjacentes à tecnologia realizem suas verificações de qualidade em todas as fases do ciclo de vida do projeto.


Pré-requisitos

• Experiência com campanhas digitais com testes em E-mails e Banners;

• Bacharel em Desenvolvimento de Software, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas;

• Inglês avançado (seu time de contato direto será global);

• Certificação em Doubleclick Banner (desejável);

• Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência como Analista de Quality Assurance ou UX;

• Conhecimento dos principais navegadores da Internet, capaz de usar Mac e PC, ter conhecimento de plug-ins de navegador como JavaScript, Flash, etc., familiarizado com tablets (Android, iPad) e smartphones;

• Experiência em ambiente de agencia de publicidade, ou similar.


Informações Adicionais:

Modelo de contratação: CLT

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Horário de trabalho: Das 10h00 ás 19h00

The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.

  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.

  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

Come join us!

Oportunidade Coordenador de Mídia | Brasil


A Pipolhub , uma AI-Media Agency e AdTech Solutions especializada em performance, presente em 7 das principais indústrias da América Latina , está em busca de um(a) Coordenador(a) de Operações para representar nossa operação no Brasil com excelência, dedicação exclusiva e visão estratégica.

Nosso diferencial :


WE EMPOWER YOUR BUSINESS with comprehensive strategies, real-time data analysis and AI technology to optimise your campaigns.

  • Media Agency : especializada em campanhas de comunicação para a indústria de apostas e gaming online na América Latina.

Nossa expertise :


  • Performance Media Strategy : estratégias de mídia baseadas em performance e dados em tempo real.
  • Business Consulting : alinhamento entre objetivos comerciais e estratégias de mídia para crescimento sustentável.

O(a) coordenador(a) será responsável por garantir agilidade, organização e excelência em toda a operação brasileira, atuando em interface com clientes, veículos, plataformas e a equipe internacional.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Planejamento de Mídia

  • Apoiar na elaboração de estratégias com base em dados de mercado e institutos de pesquisa.
  • Criar planos de mídia claros, organizados e consistentes.

Negociação com Veículos e Plataformas

  • Apoiar negociações com publishers, emissoras e plataformas.
  • Buscar constantemente novas oportunidades e atualizações do mercado.

  • Organizar e consolidar especificações técnicas.

  • Garantir auditoria de veiculação e mensuração de KPIs.

Otimização de Performance

  • Monitorar KPIs e propor ajustes ágeis.
  • Identificar oportunidades de escala e otimizar rotas de execução.

Relatórios e Pós-venda

  • Elaborar relatórios semanais de desempenho.
  • Produzir materiais de comprovação de entrega e performance.

Atividades Complementares

  • Apoiar demandas internas da operação.
  • Atuar como ponte entre Brasil e Argentina, assegurando excelência operacional.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência em mídia e operações de agência.
  • Forte capacidade de organização e agilidade.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal.
  • Disponibilidade exclusiva e comprometimento com a operação.
  • Perfil analítico, com foco em eficiência e resultados.
  • Inglês fluente
  • Espanhol será um diferencial



Pronto para alavancar sua carreira e fazer parte de uma equipe que está revolucionando o mercado de mídia com tecnologia e dados?


Junte-se à Pipolhub e venha construir o futuro da mídia conosco!

title: Arquiteto de Soluções – Oracle Retail
description:
Arquiteto de Soluções – Oracle Retail - 13069


Início: Imediato

Contrato: CLT (alocado em cliente da UltraCon)

Local de Trabalho: 100% remoto

Horário: Comercial


Habilidades Principais: Oracle Retail

Idioma: Inglês avançado


Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Soluções – Oracle Retail experiente, com profundo conhecimento em implementação, integração, otimização de performance e desenho de arquitetura de sistemas corporativos de varejo.

O(a) profissional será responsável por projetar, construir e otimizar soluções baseadas em Oracle Retail, que sustentem o processamento de grandes volumes de dados, análises e operações em ambientes empresariais.

Essa posição requer conhecimento técnico avançado dos módulos do Oracle Retail (RMS, RPM, ReSA), forte domínio em tuning de SQL, além de experiência prática em data warehousing, processos ETL e boas práticas de arquitetura.


Qualificações e Competências:

Sólida experiência em Oracle Retail, incluindo implementação, customização e integração com sistemas corporativos.

Proficiência nos principais módulos Oracle Retail, como RMS, RPM e ReSA, com foco em configuração e otimização.

Domínio de Arquitetura de Soluções, incluindo design de sistemas, análise de requisitos e implementação técnica.

Conhecimento prático em conceitos de data warehouse, como fatos/dimensões, slowly changing dimensions (tipos 1 e 2), chaves substitutas e estruturas de ETL staging.

Familiaridade com sistemas de controle de versão (ex.: Git), práticas de CI/CD e metodologias Ágeis/Scrum.


Experiência Necessária:

Experiência sólida em Arquitetura, com atuação direta em desenho de soluções Oracle Retail.

Capacidade comprovada de projetar soluções complexas para o varejo, com grande volume de dados estruturados e não estruturados, priorizando performance e escalabilidade.

Expertise em depuração, monitoramento e otimização de soluções Oracle Retail, incluindo análise de logs, resolução de problemas de integração e tuning de performance.

Experiência prévia com bancos de dados relacionais e otimização avançada de SQL voltada a análises e relatórios.

Vivência em ambientes Unix/Linux, com automação de processos em lote e criação de scripts de orquestração.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Projetar, desenvolver e manter soluções escaláveis Oracle Retail para extração, transformação e carga (ETL) de dados em data warehouses corporativos.

Escrever consultas SQL otimizadas (joins, partitions, indexing, CTEs) para suportar transformações e análises em larga escala.

Automatizar fluxos de trabalho utilizando Shell Script em Unix, incluindo tratamento de erros, geração de logs e agendamento (cron ou orquestradores corporativos).

Implementar modelos de dados em estrela e floco de neve, seguindo boas práticas de data warehousing, visando melhor desempenho e acessibilidade.

Executar tuning de performance em aplicações Oracle Retail e pipelines SQL, reduzindo latência e maximizando throughput em processamentos batch e quase em tempo real.

Colaborar com equipes de QA e negócio para implementar validações, perfis e reconciliações de dados, assegurando alta qualidade da informação.


Informações adicionais serão fornecidas durante a entrevista técnica.

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
Location: Remote (Applications open worldwide)

Compensation: $20,000 – 40,000 / year (based on experience and scope of ownership)

Skills: Semantic Search, Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering, GenAI Frameworks, React Agents, Graph Agents, Document Parsing, Python, Scalable APIs


About AnswerThis


AnswerThis is an AI-powered research platform built to eliminate the most time-consuming part of academic research: the literature review. We serve researchers globally, from PhD students to academic professionals, helping them go from query to a comprehensive, cited review in minutes.

Our system understands how papers connect, ranks relevance, summarizes insights, and maps citations. This removes weeks of manual work. But that is just the beginning. We are building a vertically integrated AI research suite that streamlines every stage of academic discovery.

If you want to design algorithms that directly accelerate science in medicine, AI, climate, and more, this is the place to do it.


The Role


We are hiring an AI Engineer to lead the development of the core intelligence behind AnswerThis. This role requires deep expertise in information retrieval, scalable backend systems, and generative AI.

You will:

  • Build and optimize semantic search pipelines, graph-based retrieval, and agentic systems.
  • Design and deploy scalable APIs and services capable of serving hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Architect, implement, and productionize vector databases and embedding-based retrieval systems.
  • Work on GenAI integrations including react agents, graph agents, prompt engineering, and LLM orchestration.
  • Set up full-stack search engines from scratch that can handle real-world academic workloads.
  • Contribute directly to the infrastructure that makes cutting-edge science more efficient.


This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will move fast, experiment, and ship production systems that impact thousands of researchers worldwide.


Requirements


  • Strong background in semantic search, vector databases, LLM frameworks, agent-based systems, and document retrieval.
  • Skilled in Python for backend development with the ability to build scalable APIs and services.
  • Past experience deploying systems at scale, including search engines, retrieval pipelines, or embedding models.
  • Ability to design infrastructure that serves hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Experience setting up and hosting APIs with public access while balancing speed, cost, and reliability.
  • A research-driven and pragmatic mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes.


Compensation


$20,000 – 40,000 / year depending on experience, expertise, and scope of ownership. This is a full-time role with significant responsibility and long-term upside.


How to Apply


Send the following to

Subject: AI Engineer Application

Include:

  • Your resume.
  • Details of past projects, especially production-level work with search, retrieval, or GenAI pipelines.
  • A short note on why you want to design algorithms at AnswerThis.


Applications without these will not be considered.

Let us build the future of research together.

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time AI Software Engineer to join our US client's team. You should have a minimum of 3 to 5+ years of experience developing and delivering commercial software, with a solid background in AI/ML, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and C#/ .NET.

In this role, you will leverage deep expertise in NLP and ML to help build scalable, production-grade language technology systems. This position is ideal for someone passionate about transformer models, audio processing, large-scale data pipelines, and real-world ML deployments.

You will have a high impact on shaping the future of language accessibility and global communication through sophisticated, scalable ML systems. If you're excited to build at the intersection of language, audio, and AI, and to do so in a real-world product used globally, we'd love to meet you.

Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide by leveraging cutting-edge speech and language AI to power solutions such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S., Europe, and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable ML-based systems focused on language processing, speech recognition, and real-time communication technologies
  • Train and fine-tune transformer-based models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, BERT, T5) for tasks such as audio transcription, classification, summarization, and conversational AI
  • Develop and deploy ML-powered microservices and APIs that integrate tightly with the platform's cloud infrastructure
  • Build and manage robust data pipelines for multilingual speech and text datasets, including cleaning, augmentation, and validation
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into production workflows with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and user experience
  • Apply software engineering best practices to assure performance, scalability, and maintainability using secure coding principles, automated unit testing, code reviews, horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, microservice architectures, and continuous integration CI/CD pipelines
  • Troubleshoot, isolate root causes, and provide innovative solutions in reasonable timeframes
  • Conduct research to evaluate and adopt emerging ML methods, with a focus on efficient inference, transfer learning, and low-latency deployment
  • Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development and AI


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3 to 5+ years of hands-on software development experience using Python, TypeScript, and C#/.NET
  • Agile development experience
  • Solid background in machine learning, with experience in supervised and unsupervised algorithms
  • Practical experience with transformers, generative models, and LLMs in NLP or audio processing
  • Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, TorchAudio, OpenAI APIs, or similar platforms
  • Expertise in developing REST APIs and microservices in production environments
  • Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Strong knowledge of AWS (S3, ECS, SageMaker, CloudWatch, Load Balancer Controller, and more)
  • Experience with NoSQL and RDBMS databases
  • Proficient in Git, Jira, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Experience building ML-based products for interpretation, transcription, or conversational interfaces
  • Previous exposure to the Microsoft Orleans distributed systems framework
  • Familiarity with Pulumi, GCP, or Azure as alternative cloud environments
  • Knowledge of innovation accelerators or previous work with AI startup toolkits
  • Familiarity with real-time data streaming and low-latency model serving

title: Sap Quality Management Consultant
description:
SAP QM Consultant (Contract) – Pharma Industry / LIMS Integration


Location: Brazil – Remote / Hybrid (depending on project)

Contract Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor

Duration: 12 months (extendable)


About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced SAP QM Consultant (Contractor) to support SAP S/4HANA implementation and enhancement projects for clients in the pharmaceutical sector .

The consultant will play a key role in designing and configuring SAP QM processes, ensuring seamless integration with LIMS (Laboratory Information Management Systems) , and maintaining compliance with GxP and pharmaceutical quality standards .

This is an excellent opportunity for independent SAP professionals who enjoy project-based work, flexibility, and the chance to collaborate in a global, regulated environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Configure and support SAP QM processes (inspection lots, results recording, batch management, certificates).
  • Design and manage SAP–LIMS integrations (LabVantage, LabWare, or equivalent).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (PP-PI, MM, WM/EWM) to align manufacturing and quality processes.
  • Ensure full GxP compliance and support validation, testing, and documentation.
  • Participate in template design, rollouts, and process improvements across global sites.
  • Provide training, functional support, and issue resolution during cutover and go-live.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of proven experience as an SAP QM Consultant .
  • Strong background in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry.
  • Hands-on LIMS integration experience (e.g., LabVantage, LabWare, etc.).
  • Working knowledge of S/4HANA , IDoc/qRFC/Web Services , and interface technologies .
  • Understanding of GMP/GxP validation and quality control processes.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is an advantage).
  • Availability to work remotely or hybrid within Brazil under a contractor model (PJ or freelance) .

The consultant will play a key role in designing and configuring SAP QM processes, ensuring seamless integration with LIMS (Laboratory Information Management Systems) , and maintaining compliance with GxP and pharmaceutical quality standards .

This is an excellent opportunity for independent SAP professionals who enjoy project-based work, flexibility, and the chance to collaborate in a global, regulated environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Configure and support SAP QM processes (inspection lots, results recording, batch management, certificates).
  • Design and manage SAP–LIMS integrations (LabVantage, LabWare, or equivalent).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (PP-PI, MM, WM/EWM) to align manufacturing and quality processes.
  • Ensure full GxP compliance and support validation, testing, and documentation.
  • Participate in template design, rollouts, and process improvements across global sites.
  • Provide training, functional support, and issue resolution during cutover and go-live.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of proven experience as an SAP QM Consultant .
  • Strong background in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry.
  • Hands-on LIMS integration experience (e.g., LabVantage, LabWare, etc.).
  • Working knowledge of S/4HANA , IDoc/qRFC/Web Services , and interface technologies .
  • Understanding of GMP/GxP validation and quality control processes.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is an advantage).
  • Availability to work remotely or hybrid within Brazil under a contractor model (PJ or freelance) .

title: Data Modeler
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The Data Modeler will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust data models and SQL-based solutions, with a focus on Google Cloud Platform. This role will ensure data integrity, optimize database performance, and support data-driven initiatives, particularly within the higher education sector.


Duties and Responsibilities:

Data Modelling and SQL Development

  • Design and implement scalable and efficient relational and dimensional data models.
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and functions.
  • Ensure data quality and integrity across various data sources and reporting layers.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into technical specifications.


Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Expertise

  • Utilize GCP services such as BigQuery, Cloud SQL, and Dataflow for data storage, processing, and analysis.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based data warehouses and data lakes on GCP.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions for GCP data environments using tools like Terraform.
  • Monitor and optimize GCP resource performance and cost for data platforms.


Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary liaison among business leads, product managers, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for data solutions.
  • Promote adoption of new data capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.


Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for data model and SQL deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for data solutions.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics related to data platforms.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational database design and data modelling.
  • Demonstrable experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data services (e.g., BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Dataflow).
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code solutions, e.g., Terraform.
  • Experience with data quality checks and data governance best practices.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience in the higher education space.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools for data platforms.
  • Familiarity with Python for data scripting and automation.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 5+ years in SQL engineering, data modelling, data engineering, or a related data-centric role, preferably within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

description:

ESPECIALIDADE NA PLATAFORMA JAVA COM IBM RATIONAL SOFTWARE ARCHITECT E IBM WEBSPHERE APPLICATION SERVER.



Requisitos Obrigatórios:

Formação de nível superior na área de informática, ou formação de nível superior

com curso de pós-graduação na área de informática ou possuir a certificação Oracle Certified Master, Java EE 6 Enterprise Architect ou superior;

Experiência exercendo atividades como arquiteto de aplicações Java EE e/ou Spring;

abaixo:

JBoss/Wildfly;

WebSphere Application Server versão 8 ou superior;

WebSphere OpenLiberty.

Experiência em Análise e tunning de performance de aplicações em servidores WebSphere Application Server;

Experiência no desenho ou construção de aplicações que possuam características como:

Uso intensivo de dados, balanceamento de carga e/ou clusterização;

Chamadas assíncronas e troca de mensagens;

Uso de serviços web SOAP e REST.

Experiência no desenho de soluções que utilizem arquitetura orientada à serviços ou micro serviços;

Experiência no uso das seguintes ferramentas: IBM Integration Bus, IBM Websphere MQ, Apache Maven e Gradle.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações que utilizem portlets, JSF (Primefaces) ou Spring;

Definir arquitetura utilizada no desenvolvimento de sistemas para implantação no IBM Websphere Application Server, incluindo modelo de persistência utilizando Java Persistence API, componentes Enterprise Java Beans, definição de serviços seguros com WS-Security e componentes de apresentação com Java Server Faces (JSF);

Definir e implementar componentes corporativos para IBM Websphere Application Server;

Criar e fazer revisões de documentos de arquitetura;

Criar procedimentos automatizados ou semiautomáticos para validação de artefatos;

Atuar nas questões de otimização de desempenho, dimensionamento de capacidade e reuso de componentes de software usando as tecnologias definidas para os projetos do cliente;

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time AI Software Engineer to join our US client's team. You should have a minimum of 3 to 5+ years of experience developing and delivering commercial software, with a solid background in AI/ML, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and C#/ .NET.

In this role, you will leverage deep expertise in NLP and ML to help build scalable, production-grade language technology systems. This position is ideal for someone passionate about transformer models, audio processing, large-scale data pipelines, and real-world ML deployments.

You will have a high impact on shaping the future of language accessibility and global communication through sophisticated, scalable ML systems. If you're excited to build at the intersection of language, audio, and AI, and to do so in a real-world product used globally, we'd love to meet you.

Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide by leveraging cutting-edge speech and language AI to power solutions such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S., Europe, and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable ML-based systems focused on language processing, speech recognition, and real-time communication technologies
  • Train and fine-tune transformer-based models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, BERT, T5) for tasks such as audio transcription, classification, summarization, and conversational AI
  • Develop and deploy ML-powered microservices and APIs that integrate tightly with the platform's cloud infrastructure
  • Build and manage robust data pipelines for multilingual speech and text datasets, including cleaning, augmentation, and validation
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into production workflows with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and user experience
  • Apply software engineering best practices to assure performance, scalability, and maintainability using secure coding principles, automated unit testing, code reviews, horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, microservice architectures, and continuous integration CI/CD pipelines
  • Troubleshoot, isolate root causes, and provide innovative solutions in reasonable timeframes
  • Conduct research to evaluate and adopt emerging ML methods, with a focus on efficient inference, transfer learning, and low-latency deployment
  • Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development and AI


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3 to 5+ years of hands-on software development experience using Python, TypeScript, and C#/.NET
  • Agile development experience
  • Solid background in machine learning, with experience in supervised and unsupervised algorithms
  • Practical experience with transformers, generative models, and LLMs in NLP or audio processing
  • Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, TorchAudio, OpenAI APIs, or similar platforms
  • Expertise in developing REST APIs and microservices in production environments
  • Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Strong knowledge of AWS (S3, ECS, SageMaker, CloudWatch, Load Balancer Controller, and more)
  • Experience with NoSQL and RDBMS databases
  • Proficient in Git, Jira, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Experience building ML-based products for interpretation, transcription, or conversational interfaces
  • Previous exposure to the Microsoft Orleans distributed systems framework
  • Familiarity with Pulumi, GCP, or Azure as alternative cloud environments
  • Knowledge of innovation accelerators or previous work with AI startup toolkits
  • Familiarity with real-time data streaming and low-latency model serving

You will have a high impact on shaping the future of language accessibility and global communication through sophisticated, scalable ML systems. If you're excited to build at the intersection of language, audio, and AI, and to do so in a real-world product used globally, we'd love to meet you.

Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide by leveraging cutting-edge speech and language AI to power solutions such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S., Europe, and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable ML-based systems focused on language processing, speech recognition, and real-time communication technologies
  • Train and fine-tune transformer-based models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, BERT, T5) for tasks such as audio transcription, classification, summarization, and conversational AI
  • Develop and deploy ML-powered microservices and APIs that integrate tightly with the platform's cloud infrastructure
  • Build and manage robust data pipelines for multilingual speech and text datasets, including cleaning, augmentation, and validation
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into production workflows with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and user experience
  • Apply software engineering best practices to assure performance, scalability, and maintainability using secure coding principles, automated unit testing, code reviews, horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, microservice architectures, and continuous integration CI/CD pipelines
  • Troubleshoot, isolate root causes, and provide innovative solutions in reasonable timeframes
  • Conduct research to evaluate and adopt emerging ML methods, with a focus on efficient inference, transfer learning, and low-latency deployment
  • Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development and AI


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3 to 5+ years of hands-on software development experience using Python, TypeScript, and C#/.NET
  • Agile development experience
  • Solid background in machine learning, with experience in supervised and unsupervised algorithms
  • Practical experience with transformers, generative models, and LLMs in NLP or audio processing
  • Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, TorchAudio, OpenAI APIs, or similar platforms
  • Expertise in developing REST APIs and microservices in production environments
  • Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Strong knowledge of AWS (S3, ECS, SageMaker, CloudWatch, Load Balancer Controller, and more)
  • Experience with NoSQL and RDBMS databases
  • Proficient in Git, Jira, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Experience building ML-based products for interpretation, transcription, or conversational interfaces
  • Previous exposure to the Microsoft Orleans distributed systems framework
  • Familiarity with Pulumi, GCP, or Azure as alternative cloud environments
  • Knowledge of innovation accelerators or previous work with AI startup toolkits
  • Familiarity with real-time data streaming and low-latency model serving

We are looking for a seasoned Staff Software Engineer who brings advanced technical acumen and an ability to take broad ownership. title: Consultor SAP ABAP PI Sênior
description:
Desenvolvedor(a) SAP ABAP | WF | PI/PO

Contrato PJ | 12 meses | 100% remoto

Objetivo

Atuar no design, desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções SAP com foco em ABAP, Workflows complexos e integrações via PI/PO, assegurando qualidade técnica e estabilidade dos fluxos.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter objetos ABAP: reports (básicos e avançados), ALV OO, módulos de função, Module Pool, BAPIs, BDC, Smart Forms e OO ABAP.
  • Implementar enhancements: implicit/explicit, BADIs, User Exits.
  • Projetar, construir e administrar SAP Business Workflow: fluxos complexos, notificações repetitivas, work items dinâmicos, tarefas em background, questionários, anexos por e-mail e troubleshooting.
  • Criar integrações INBOUND/OUTBOUND entre SAP e legados via PI/PO e Proxy ABAP.
  • Configurar integrações: destinos RFC (R/3 e PI), portas, perfis de parceiro, sistemas lógicos e proxy ABAP.
  • Configurar e testar adaptadores: HTTP, HTTPS, FTPS, SOAP, REST.
  • Elaborar e executar testes: unitário, integração e interfaces PI/PO; preparar documentação técnica e de mapeamento.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida em SAP ABAP com os itens citados acima.
  • Vivência comprovada em SAP Business Workflow com administração e resolução de incidentes.
  • Experiência prática em PI/PO: cenários síncronos/assíncronos, mapeamentos, monitoramento e performance.
  • Configuração de RFC, parceiros e proxies ABAP.
  • Preparação de planos e evidências de teste.
  • Boa organização para documentar especificação técnica e de mapeamento.


Diferenciais

  • Boas práticas de performance ABAP e troubleshooting de integrações.
  • Noções de segurança em integrações e tratamento de erros.
  • Experiência com governança de mudanças e versionamento.


Modelo e condições

  • Contrato: PJ.
  • Período: 12 meses, com possibilidade de extensão conforme entrega e demanda.
  • Local: 100% remoto.
  • Dedicação: integral (40h/semana) ou a combinar conforme volume.
  • Início: imediato, após aprovação técnica.


Processo seletivo

  • Entrevista Talent
  • Entrevista técnica
  • Contratação do PS

title: Webflow Designer
description:
SOBRE A LETS


A LETS é uma empresa de tecnologia que atua na integração de canais de venda com operadores logísticos, potencializando resultados de negócios por meio de soluções inovadoras. Nosso sistema SaaS, chamado Max, é a espinha dorsal que conecta varejistas, operadores logísticos e canais de venda de forma eficiente e automatizada, oferecendo uma experiência simplificada e eficaz para todos os envolvidos. Nossa missão é desenvolver soluções tecnológicas inovadoras que maximizem o desempenho e a eficiência dos negócios, capacitando empresas a alcançar resultados excepcionais.


Estamos crescendo rapidamente e buscamos talentos que queiram fazer parte de nossa jornada, ajudando a transformar o ecossistema de tecnologia e logística para negócios. Se você é uma pessoa com olhar apurado para produto digital, experiência do usuário e front-end em plataformas low-code/no-code como o Webflow , a LET'S é o seu lugar!


SOBRE A VAGA


Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista de Webflow & Experiência Digital para liderar a evolução do nosso site, blog, landing pages e hubs de conteúdo — conectando marca, performance e produto em uma experiência consistente.


É um papel híbrido entre UX/UI Designer e Front-end Low-Code : alguém que entende jornada, navegação, hierarquia de informação, microcopy e conversão, mas também entra no Webflow para estruturar coleções dinâmicas, componentes, interações, integrações e ajustes finos de layout, responsividade e performance.


Você será “dono(a)” do nosso ecossistema Webflow (e ferramentas associadas), garantindo que tudo esteja organizado, escalável e fácil de manter, sempre conectado com times de Marketing, Growth, Produto e Vendas.


ATIVIDADES:


  • Arquitetura e UX do site : estruturar menus, páginas, fluxos, componentes e coleções (CMS) alinhados à estratégia da LETS e dos produtos (Max SalesCloud, Bippi, FiboNash, etc.).
  • Implementação no Webflow : construir e manter páginas, layouts, coleções dinâmicas, formulários, interações, animações e variações responsivas (mobile-first).
  • Design System & consistência visual : organizar estilos globais (tipografia, cores, grids, componentes), garantindo coerência entre site, blog, LPs e materiais digitais.
  • Performance & SEO On-page : otimizar estrutura, headings, imagens, meta tags, URLs, links internos e boas práticas Core Web Vitals.
  • Integrações & low-code : configurar integrações com ferramentas como HubSpot, AirOps, n8n, WhatsApp/API, analytics, pixels e outros conectores sem depender sempre de dev.
  • Experimentação & conversão : propor e testar variações de páginas, CTAs, formulários e mensagens para melhorar conversão, engajamento e qualificação de leads.
  • Criação de estruturas de landing pages: desenvolver e criar modelos de landing pages escaláveis para eventos, material RICO, e outras formas de conteúdo.
  • Documentação & escalabilidade : registrar padrões, boas práticas e guidelines para que o ecossistema Webflow seja sustentável, organizado e fácil de evoluir.
  • Curiosidade técnica : explorar novas features, clonables, bibliotecas e soluções low-code/no-code que ajudem a levar o site “um passo além” sempre.


REQUISITOS:


Eliminatórios (OBRIGATÓRIO):

  • Experiência comprovada (3+ anos) construindo sites, LPs e projetos profissionais em Webflow .
  • Domínio de UX/UI básico a intermediário : wireframes, hierarquia de informação, boas práticas de navegação e usabilidade.
  • Conhecimento sólido de HTML e CSS (para ajustar o que o Webflow gera e criar soluções mais refinadas).
  • Noções de JavaScript suficientes para pequenas interações, embeds e integrações simples.
  • Experiência com design responsivo e otimização para mobile.
  • Capacidade de leitura e entendimento de documentação técnica, tutoriais e comunidades (inclusive em inglês).
  • Perfil hands-on, curioso, autônomo , com vontade de testar, fuçar, perguntar (inclusive para IAs) e aprender rápido.


HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS:


  • Experiência com Figma ou ferramenta similar para prototipação.
  • Familiaridade com integrações Webflow ↔ HubSpot , formulários, CRM, automações (n8n/Make/Zapier).
  • Conhecimento em SEO técnico , Analytics, Tag Manager e pixels.

title: High Ticket closer
description:
ABOUT US


Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE


We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

title: Latin America Finance Business Partner - Sales & Marketing and Field Operations
description:
Latin America Finance Business Partner - Sales & Marketing and Field Operations


Role Overview:


We are seeking a proactive, dynamic and hands-on Finance Business Partner to support our Sales & Marketing and Field Operations teams across the Latin America region. This is a high-impact role where you will play a critical part in driving business performance, offering strategic financial insights, and providing actionable recommendations to enable growth and operational efficiency. You will be the key finance partner for these teams, working closely with Latam senior leadership to track field and sales performance, and ensure that business goals are met within budget.


On a typical day you will:


  • Strategic Financial Partnering: Serve as a trusted partner to Sales & Marketing and Field Operations teams, working on the databases and providing financial insights that drive decision-making and support business strategies.
  • Budgeting & Forecasting: Lead the budgeting and forecasting process for Sales & Marketing and Field Operations organizations. Develop and maintain rolling forecasts, track budget variances, and ensure financial targets are aligned with operational goals.
  • Business Performance Analysis: Analyze financial data and key performance metrics for both Sales & Marketing and Field Operations. Provide insights into revenue generation, profitability, and cost control, helping to optimize spending and improve financial outcomes.
  • Cost Management & Efficiency: Collaborate with operational leaders to identify areas for cost reduction, process improvements, and operational efficiencies within the sales and field operations domains.
  • Financial Reporting: Prepare regular financial reports and presentations for senior management, highlighting key trends, risks, and opportunities in the business. Present clear, actionable recommendations based on financial analysis.
  • KPIs and Metrics: Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor the success of sales and marketing campaigns and field operations. Ensure alignment with business objectives and provide actionable recommendations for improvement.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with world headquarters in Finance, Sales & Marketing, and Field Operations, fostering collaboration and ensuring alignment between financial and operational goals.
  • Ad Hoc Financial Support: Provide ad-hoc financial analysis and support as needed for special projects, strategic initiatives, and decision-making processes.


What You Will Need to be Successful:


  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Accounting, Economics or Engineering (MBA or professional finance qualification preferred).
  • Fluent English and Spanish. Strong interaction with Latin America countries and headquarters in the United States, through conference calls and in person meetings.
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in managerial roles as finance business partnering, and/or financial planning & analysis, ideally with experience in Sales & Marketing and/or Operations environments.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial data, draw insights, and make strategic recommendations.
  • Business Acumen: Understanding of sales, marketing, and field operations metrics and the ability to translate these into actionable financial strategies.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to present complex financial data in a clear and compelling way to non-financial stakeholders.
  • Advanced Excel skills (including financial modeling) and Hyperion Financial Management (HFM) Oracle Hyperion Financial Management.
  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work cross-functionally with various business units and senior leadership to influence decision-making.
  • Problem Solving: Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to identifying financial trends and issues.


Apply today to join us and Build What’s Next!

title: M365 & IAM Engineer
description:
We never ask for payment as part of our selection process, and we always contact candidates via our corporate accounts and platforms. If you are approached for payment, this is likely to be fraudulent. Please check to see whether the role you are interested in is posted on our career website.


About TMF Group

TMF Group is a leading provider of critical administrative services, helping clients invest and operate safely around the world. We provide legal, financial, and employee administration through TMF Group’s teams in 120 offices.

Our 9,100 experts and 120 offices in 85 jurisdictions worldwide serve corporates, financial institutions, asset managers, private clients and family offices, providing the combination of accounting, tax, payroll, fund administration, compliance and entity management services essential to global business success.

We help businesses achieve global compliance, transparency and consistency.


Discover the Role

We are seeking a skilled and proactive M365 and IAM Engineer to manage, secure, and optimize our Microsoft 365 environment and Identity & Access Management systems , On-Prem and Azure Active directory , Pas Services.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with M365 services, Azure Active Directory, and IAM tools, ensuring secure and seamless access to enterprise resources.


Key Responsibilities

Microsoft 365 Administration:

- Manage and support M365 services including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, and Intune.

- Team Telephony

- Implement and maintain M365 security and compliance features (DLP, ATP, Conditional Access, etc.).

- Monitor service health, usage, and performance; troubleshoot and resolve issues.

- Automate tasks using PowerShell scripting.

Identity & Access Management (IAM):

- Administer and maintain Azure Active Directory (AAD), including user provisioning, SSO, MFA, and conditional access policies.

- Integrate IAM solutions with cloud and on-prem applications.

- Manage lifecycle of user identities and access rights across systems.

- Conduct regular access reviews and audits to ensure compliance.

- ADFS

Security & Compliance:

- Collaborate with security teams to enforce identity governance and data protection policies.

- Respond to security incidents related to identity and access.

- Ensure compliance with regulatory standards


Key Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

- 3–5 years of experience in M365 administration and IAM.

- Strong knowledge of Azure AD, Active Directory, and M365 security features.

- Experience with IAM tools

- Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills.

Preferred Certifications:

- Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals


What’s in it for you?

Pathways for career development

  • Work with colleagues and clients around the world on interesting and challenging work.
  • We provide internal career opportunities, so you can take your career further within TMF.
  • Continuous development is supported through global learning opportunities from the TMF Business Academy.

Making an impact

  • You’ll be helping us to make the world a simpler place to do business for our clients.
  • Through our corporate social responsibility program, you’ll also be making a difference in the communities where we work.

A supportive environment

  • Strong feedback culture to help build an engaging workplace.
  • Regardless of where you are in your career, TMF Group opens a world of opportunity where you will be part of our team and is supported in your global career journey.
  • Our inclusive work environment allows you to work from our offices around the world, as well as from home, helping you find the right work-life balance to perform at your best.
  • At TMF Group, it’s our people who make us who we are. Our company thrives on entrepreneurial spirit and is full of proactive people who combine enthusiasm with responsibility and accountability.

Other Benefits

  • Anniversary & Birthday Leave policy
  • Be part of One TMF
  • Paternity & Adoption leaves
  • Salary advance policy
  • Work flexibility – Hybrid work model
  • Talk about growth opportunities (we invest in talent)
  • Well-being initiatives


We’re looking forward to getting to know you!

title: Mid/Senior Vue.js Software Engineer
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!


VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.


We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)


We’re seeking a Frontend Engineer to help us build intuitive, performant, and modern user experiences with Vue.js and TypeScript . You’ll have the opportunity to work closely with talented engineers and designers, turning ideas into high-quality digital products that impact thousands of users.


What you will do :

  • Develop responsive and elegant web applications using Vue.js and TypeScript.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs and improve data flow.
  • Translate design mockups into reusable and scalable components.
  • Continuously optimize applications for performance and accessibility.
  • Ensure cross-browser compatibility and a great user experience on all devices.
  • Participate in code reviews and actively contribute to the team’s technical growth.


What we expect from you :

Mid-level:

  • Strong experience with Vue.js and its ecosystem (Vuex, Vue Router, etc.).
  • Solid knowledge of TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Experience integrating REST APIs and working with version control (Git).
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks (Playwright).
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Senior-level:

  • Proven expertise in Vue.js and TypeScript, delivering complex and scalable frontends.
  • Ability to make architectural decisions and lead UI performance improvements.
  • Strong UX awareness and experience collaborating with design teams.
  • Experience mentoring and supporting junior engineers.
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Additional Information:

  • CLT employment type;
  • Working schedule follows the Portugal time zone.


If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Consultor de Investimentos WS - Parceiros XP | Rio Grande do Sul
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;

  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;

Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

A Atos é uma empresa líder mundial em transformação digital, oferecendo serviços de transação de alta tecnologia, consultoria, integração de sistemas, cloud e serviços gerenciados. Além disso, anunciada como parceira mundial de TI nos Jogos Olímpicos e Paraolímpicos!


Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.


Buscamos um Consultor SAP Abap Pleno para atuação remota em cliente Atos.


Irá atuar com sustentação e melhorias com ABAP e Workflow.


Requisitos:

Programação orientada a objeto

BTP conhecimentos básicos

Fiori

SEGW/ODATA

CDS

Workflow

(Java, C++,...)




Benefícios:

  • Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação
  • Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos
  • Plano odontológico
  • Programa de remuneração variável
  • Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade
  • Wellhub (Gympass)
  • Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos
  • Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional
  • Seguro de vida
  • Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa)
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas)
  • Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas)
  • Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)
  • Programa de treinamentos internos e externos
  • Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente)
  • Espaço Saúde (suporte com atendimento médico - presencial ou online - para os funcionários e seus familiares e contamos também com os programas de bem-estar e qualidade de vida)
  • Terapia online
  • Massoterapia
  • Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges)
  • Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro
  • Day off no seu aniversário
  • Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos)
  • Bônus de indicação para nossas vagas (conforme política interna)
  • Jubileu (premiação personalizada por tempo de empresa)
  • Accolade (Programa de reconhecimento)






Aviso de Proteção de Dados

Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos.

Caso haja alguma dúvida relacionada à proteção de dados ou qualquer aspecto envolvendo o tratamento realizado, você pode entrar em contato por meio do canal:

Acesse aqui o nosso aviso de proteção de dados para saber mais sobre o tratamento de dados pessoais realizado pela Atos.

Privacy Notice


The personal data collected will be used exclusively for the recruitment process and processed according to the security guidelines introduced by Atos.

If you have any questions related to privacy or any aspect related to processing activities, you can contact us by e-mail:

Click here to access our privacy notice and to get to know more about Atos processing of personal data.
